# Surface matrix

Every user-facing route, what owns its data, and what it owes the user with the radio off. This is the scope of the offline program (#486): a route added without a row fails `npm run check:surfaces`, and so does a `precached` claim on a page that cannot be prerendered.

`shell` describes the remote document. The app has no bundle, so there is no `bundle` column: a surface the app does not draw natively is the document. `Paint` names the row in `perf/paint-budget.json` that the paint gate measures (#558); an empty cell is a row the gate cannot see yet.
